verdict.rationale: A live probe found https://docs.vapi.ai/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section, and it says any docs page is available as clean Markdown by appending `.md`. The CLI docs also say IDE AI assistants gain accurate knowledge of Vapi's APIs. missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and the full llms.txt contents (only the opening was probed).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
